label_limitations: Source-specific auxiliary classification only. Reject has no published biological confirmation procedure and is not automatically rotten or the operational REJECT_SUSPECT class. Fertilized and Unfertilized retain original meanings; neither is mapped to Day 16/18. Age, physical egg IDs, and outcome ground truth are unavailable. Multi-egg frames require source-labelled bounding-box crops; preserve image families across splits.
